key_reasoning.reason: Security-relevant iframe sandbox hardening: sandbox value is restricted to allow-scripts only and forbidden tokens (allow-same-origin, allow-forms, allow-popups, etc.) are excluded and pinned by new tests. Uses the native platform sandbox mechanism, no novel code, fully reversible, and the injection surface is explicitly covered by new forbidden-token test suites in both htmlPreviewSandbox.test.ts and HtmlPreviewPopup.test.tsx.
